blurb: Nickelodeon Universe is an indoor theme park featuring rides, attractions, and entertainment based on Nickelodeon characters. Guests can enjoy a variety of rides requiring wristbands or point passes, and additional attractions like miniature golf and interactive experiences. The park offers group pricing, birthday parties, and special programs for school groups.
